modern: Do not be whirled about, but in every movement have regard to justice, and whenever an impression comes, keep hold of your power of understanding.
original: Do not be whirled about, but in every movement have respect to justice, and on the occasion of every impression maintain the faculty of comprehension [or understanding].

explained.summary: Don’t get spun around by every impulse. Whatever you do, keep fairness in view, and whenever a thought or impression arrives, hold on to your judgement instead of being carried off by it. Marcus is describing a mind that stays steady while things move around it.
explained.today: A sharp email arrives and you feel an instant urge to fire one back. That’s the impression. Keeping hold of your judgement is pausing long enough to ask whether it actually deserves the reply you’re drafting.
